mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate, sustained below 0.1% for at least three consecutive months, signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%, or the average 20-day return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over two consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and reduces corporate earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 650,000 units in two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced confidence in the real estate sector, which negatively impacts broader economic sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 94.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic momentum and reduces corporate profitability expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% within a 3-month window, combined with a decline in industrial production below 94.0, indicates a tightening monetary policy during a weakening supply environment, which increases the risk of stagflation and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate above 8.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 131,000 in two consecutive months signals a severe labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, combined with a drop in housing starts below 685,000 units, indicates a sharp contraction in private demand, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).
